subject: Mutual Action Plan: POC gating — org seed, ephemeral keys, IP safe-list & VPC peering timeline
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@mednano.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — initial asks for MAP

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the call this morning — excited to get the POC started. Per our discussion, here's a short list of gating items we'd like captured in the MAP so internal engineering and security can sign off quickly: 

- Org setup/SSO mapping and which accounts need access (we'll provide SCIM info next week).
- API key provisioning for test vs production slices (short lived preferred).
- IP allowlist ranges for outbound egress and any public endpoints we need to open.
- VPC peering: we need a draft network diagram and proposed CIDR ranges.

Can you send a MAP draft with responsibilities and target dates? We're trying to align to a 3-week tight evaluation window if possible.

Best,
Priya Shah
Director of Engineering
MedNano

Hi Priya — thanks, great to meet you today.

I've attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_MedNano_v0.1.xlsx) that breaks down the four gating items you listed into owners, deliverables, and target dates. High level:

- Org seed & SSO: target 2026-08-20 for initial SCIM + test user provisioning (owner: Marissa).
- API keys: we can issue ephemeral test keys for the POC by 2026-08-19 (owner: Rachel/Ben).
- IP allowlist: please provide the egress ranges you will need; we'll provide Redwood endpoint IPs and recommend a narrow port set. Target 2026-08-21 for allowlist confirmation (owner: Neha).
- VPC peering: Ben will draft the network diagram + CIDR proposal by 2026-08-22; peering request can be submitted to your cloud admin once diagram is approved.

Two asks for you to unblock us quickly:
1) Confirm the test SSO account email addresses and whether you want SCIM write enabled.
2) Share the team POC contact for network (name + email + Slack).

I'll loop Ben/Neha on the technical bits below. If this timeline works, we'll lock the MAP and convert it into a mutual action tracker.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the MAP attached.

Best,

Ben / Neha / Marissa — forwarding Priya's ask and the MAP draft I just sent. Quick notes:

- Ben: can you produce the simple network diagram (single-page) and recommended CIDRs for VPC peering? Keep it conservative — MedNano wants to keep their CIDRs contiguous.
- Neha: I'll need the exact public IPs (or ranges) we provide for allowlist. Also confirm whether MedNano prefers ephemeral API keys vs long lived test keys for the POC.
- Marissa: you'll take lead on SSO/SCIM mapping and confirmation with Priya.

Target dates in the MAP are optimistic to hit their 3-week evaluation window. If any of you see major blockers, call them out here and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Rachel

Subject: Re: Fwd: POC kickoff — initial asks for MAP

Quick technical plan and deliverables (ETA in parentheses):

1) Network diagram + CIDR proposal (2026-08-19): will include a minimal peering layout, suggested route tables, and security group guidance. Attached small checklist.
2) IP allowlist for Redwood endpoints (2026-08-18): Neha will produce the public egress IP ranges and the specific ports to open (http/https + 443).
3) Ephemeral API keys workflow (2026-08-19): we'll create time-bound keys for the POC and a simple rotate script. We will not require full production KMS for the POC.
4) VPC peering request template (2026-08-20): cloud admin-ready doc you can paste into your console request.

Notes/risks:
- If MedNano requires private peering with strict NACLs and separate transit, that can add 3–5 business days. Call this out up front.
- SCIM write access will speed SSO mapping but requires their IdP admin.

Attached: redwood-network-asklist.md (stub) — contains the fields we'll need from MedNano to provision peering and keys.

Thanks, Rachel + team — this looks good and the dates are reasonable. A few items from our side: 

- Network POC contact: Samuel Ortiz (samuel.ortiz@mednano.com), he'll own peering.
- We prefer ephemeral API keys for the test window — please include TTL = 72 hours.
- SCIM: we'll enable SCIM write for a test group (details coming 2026-08-18 11:00 PST).
- Our cloud admin noted that the peering will need a maintenance window to accept routes — we can schedule acceptance 2026-08-24 if Ben's diagram is ready by 08-19.

We'll review the MAP spreadsheet and return any small edits by EOD 2026-08-18.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
